summary: Added two test files (skill-groups and sidebar-reorder), fixed an integration-test assertion, migrated 30 remaining empty/error call sites to a new ResourceNote component, removed the redundant settings title band, then extended MessageList's pin-to-end settle loop so a 424-message thread no longer shows blank space when switched to.
decisions:
Replaced

markup with a shared component in WorkspaceScreen.svelte and SkillsSettings.svelte, so tone/role/live behavior lives in one place.

Removed the settings-screen header band but kept an sr-only

Settings

so the screen still has an accessible name, and collapsed the [data-ui='settings-screen'] grid to a single track.

MessageList pinToEnd now waits for `settleFrames` (8) consecutive unchanged frames or `settleTimeout` (4000 ms) before releasing auto-follow, and cancels the settle immediately on wheel/touchstart so manual scroll still wins.
errors: Initial test run failed: workspace-navigation.integration.test.ts expected 1 thread row but got 2; fixed by re-querying the thread list from `threads?.querySelectorAll(...)` instead of the parent list.

check-ui-hooks.mjs flagged [data-ui='resource-empty'|'resource-error'] as dead hooks even though ResourceNote now sets `data-ui` dynamically; flagged [data-ui='settings-screen-header'] h1/span rules whose ancestor markup was just removed.
